summary.result: The results of the Building Energy Simulation(BES) indicated that the system B, the upgraded ventilation system made 8% lower total heating load and 47% lower at only the broiler zone compared to the conventional broiler house.
summary.background: Most of the broiler houses in Korea have experienced problems on controlling the environmental conditions such as suitability, stability and uniformity of rearing condition inside the broiler house.
summary.method: In this study, the heating load of a naturally ventilated broiler house was calculated using TRANSYS 15 BES program while internal climate and thermal condition were computed using Fluent 6.2.

summary_ko.method: 본 연구에서는 자연환기식 육계사의 난방부하를 TRNSYS 15 BES 프로그램을 이용하여 계산하였으며, 내부 기후 및 열 상태는 Fluent 6.2를 사용하여 계산하였다.
